personal_info.name: Ayush Tiwari
personal_info.title: Machine Learning and AI Engineer
personal_info.summary: Machine Learning and AI Engineer with hands-on experience building end-to-end machine learning models, deep learning systems, computer vision applications, and Generative AI / LLM solutions. Proficient in Python, SQL, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn, PyTorch-style CNN architectures, OpenCV, LangChain, FastAPI, Docker, and Git. Experienced in data pipeline engineering, feature engineering, model evaluation, and production-oriented deployment. Strong foundation in Data Science, Statistical Modelling, and AI Engineering with a track record of measurable performance improvements across ML pipelines.

highlights: Built scalable machine learning data pipelines using Python and DuckDB to process and analyze 79M+ records, enabling efficient feature engineering and model development.
Engineered and optimized data preprocessing workflows, reducing data preparation time by 50%+ while improving reliability and reproducibility of machine learning experiments.

Developed and evaluated predictive machine learning models on large-scale datasets, leveraging feature engineering and automated validation pipelines to accelerate experimentation and improve model performance.
Built scalable data preprocessing and evaluation pipelines for 25,000+ records, improving inference efficiency by 40% and supporting rapid model experimentation.
Developed and integrated LLM-powered features using Python, prompt engineering, and API-based models to automate text processing and enhance user experience.

projects.name: CardioSense AI
details: Developed an end-to-end deep learning-based ECG diagnostic system using CNNs trained on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Dataset for automated binary classification of cardiac signals.
Engineered a real-time signal processing pipeline for ECG normalization, R-peak detection, heart rate estimation, and waveform visualization, improving model prediction interpretability.

projects.name: Customer Segmentation Engine (Customer-Seg)
details: Achieved 94.2% clustering purity on the validation dataset; integrated Google Gemini via LangChain to generate personalized marketing strategies and retention recommendations for 100% of predicted customer profiles.
Containerized the application using Docker and built an interactive Streamlit dashboard featuring real-time prediction, secure API key management, and dataset exploration for scalable deployment.

qa_pairs.question: What is Ayush's main coding language?
qa_pairs.answer: Ayush's primary language is Python, which he uses extensively for machine learning, data engineering pipelines, and LLM integrations. He is also proficient in SQL, C, and MATLAB.

qa_pairs.question: Does Ayush have experience with Vector Databases?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, Ayush works with Vector Databases and LLMs for building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, agentic workflows, and semantic search features, including this Digital Twin portfolio itself.

qa_pairs.question: Can Ayush build data engineering pipelines?
qa_pairs.answer: Absolutely. During his internship at 10x.ai, he built scalable pipelines using Python and DuckDB to process and analyze over 79 million records, reducing data preparation times by over 50%.

qa_pairs.question: What kind of 3D Digital Twin is this?
qa_pairs.answer: This portfolio displays a glowing, interactive holographic 3D neon brain model representing Ayush's AI Digital Twin, symbolizing computational intelligence, deep neural networks, and a clean, high-performance tech aesthetic.

qa_pairs.question: Where is Ayush based and is he open to relocation?
qa_pairs.answer: Ayush is currently based in Etawah, India, and is studying at IIT Guwahati. He is open to remote roles, internships, and potential relocations depending on the opportunity details.
